meta.note: Maps a 2020-vintage tract GEOID to the 2010-vintage tract GEOID(s) it overlaps by >=1% of its land area. Identity pairs (unchanged GEOID) are omitted — a 2020 GEOID absent from this map either is unchanged (same 2010 GEOID) or had no meaningful 2010 overlap.
